description: The city was a free-text box, so one place arrives in five spellings: 'Bengaluru', 'Bangalore', 'bangalore', 'BLR' and 'Banglore'. Split five ways, each looks small, but merged they are the biggest market by far, well ahead of Pune. city.value_counts() shows the variants side by side. Bangalore was officially renamed Bengaluru in 2014, and both names are still in everyday use, which makes this a classic real-world cleaning trap; the company and its data are fictional.
hints: For each text column, look at value_counts(). Are the categories really distinct?
Read the whole list of places people signed up from, not just the top few.
'Bengaluru', 'Bangalore', 'bangalore', 'BLR' and 'Banglore' are one place. Merged, it beats Pune.
